title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on Matthew 15: the tradition of the elders, what defiles a man, the Canaanite woman and the four thousand fed.

questions.text: What did the Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem complain about?
questions.explanation: They asked why his disciples disobey the tradition of the elders, since they don't wash their hands when they eat bread.

answers.text: His disciples pluck grain on the Sabbath
His disciples don't wash their hands
His disciples don't fast like the Pharisees
His disciples eat with tax collectors

questions.text: Which commandment of God did he quote about parents?
questions.explanation: He said that God commanded: Honor your father and your mother.

answers.text: Honor your father and your mother
You shall not make false vows
You shall not swear by your head

questions.text: What did the quotation from Isaiah say about these people's heart?
questions.explanation: The quotation says they draw near with their mouth and honor him with their lips, but their heart is far from him.

answers.text: Their heart is pure before him
Their lips are closed to him
Their heart is far from him

questions.text: What did Jesus say defiles a man?
questions.explanation: He said that what enters into the mouth doesn't defile the man, but what proceeds out of the mouth defiles him.

answers.text: What comes out of the mouth

questions.text: What did Jesus call the Pharisees who were offended by his saying?
questions.explanation: He told the disciples to leave them alone, because they are blind guides of the blind.

answers.text: Teachers of the law of Moses

questions.text: According to Matthew 15:19, what comes out of the heart?
questions.explanation: Out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony and blasphemies.

questions.text: Who came out from the borders of Tyre and Sidon crying for mercy for her daughter?
questions.explanation: A Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried for mercy, because her daughter was severely possessed by a demon.

questions.text: What did the woman answer about the dogs?
questions.explanation: She said: Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

answers.text: The children's bread is enough for all
She would wait until the children ate
Even the dogs eat the crumbs from the table
She asked for bread for the dogs

questions.text: Whom did the multitude glorify when they saw the mute speaking and the lame walking?
questions.explanation: The multitude wondered at what they saw and glorified the God of Israel.

questions.text: How many men ate, in addition to women and children?
questions.explanation: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.
